research.excerpt: The arc of Mechaskypenis is a tragic arc, / the plight of the machined shadow / in the palm of a great forest, / a dead forest, a forest of rot and emptiness. // Flames licked at the curtains inside him, fire / in his house, smoke in his childhood bedroom / too thick to see through for 18 summers.
